mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 new jobs per month signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,200,000 units annually, it indicates a robust housing market that stimulates economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and stagnant monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) signals an impending monetary tightening cycle that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth rate > 2.0%), economic expansion supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%.
